title: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? In
question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.

prediction.sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_lr,
    AVG("loss_rate_%" * "loss_rate_%") - AVG("loss_rate_%") * AVG("loss_rate_%") AS var_lr
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
)
SELECT
  s.avg_lr AS avg_loss_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" < s.avg_lr - SQRT(s.var_lr) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_one_std,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" > s.avg_lr + SQRT(s.var_lr) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_one_std,
  SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" BETWEEN s.avg_lr - SQRT(s.var_lr) AND s.avg_lr + SQRT(s.var_lr) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_one_std
FROM veg_loss_rate_df AS v
CROSS JOIN stats AS s

  SELECT "loss_rate_%",
         AVG("loss_rate_%") OVER () AS avg_lr,
         (AVG("loss_rate_%")*AVG("loss_rate_%") OVER () - AVG(AVG("loss_rate_%")*AVG("loss_rate_%") OVER ()) OVER ()) AS var_lr
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
)
SELECT

  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" < avg_lr - SQRT(var_lr) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_one_std,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" > avg_lr + SQRT(var_lr) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_one_std,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" BETWEEN avg_lr - SQRT(var_lr) AND avg_lr + SQRT(var_lr) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_one_std
FROM base
